calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, negate the trailing three completed daily open-to-close returns. A positive score identifies recent intraday losers and favors short-horizon mean reversion.
calculation.timing: Signal is lagged through the last completed session; forward returns begin on the next available session.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in each tested regime; small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty. Signal is selective in the merged daily calendar because open/close observations are unavailable on non-session dates, but valid dates average 14.07 names.

provenance.artifact_format: wide CSV keyed by date and symbol columns
